newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Marin insists Israel must respect peace accord.
newsitem.headline: Marin insists Israel must respect peace accord.

text.p: The Israeli government cannot renege on the Middle East peace accord on the grounds that it was signed by the previous administration, Commissioner Manuel Marin said on Tuesday.
"The Oslo accord must be respected and cannot be changed by the Israeli government," Marin told the European Parliament's development committee.
"The Oslo accord was signed by the Israeli state and the Palestinians with the agreement of the international community.

"If all the governments in the world said, like the Israeli government, that the agreement was signed by the last government and needed to be renegotiated, there would be a breakdown in international security and we would return to the law of the jungle," Marin warned.
"Israel has to honour the agreements," he insisted.
